1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""hsim - end-user entry point for the Andes hybrid simulator.
3	
4	Single-file driver. Wraps the developer-grade scripts (setup.sh,
5	tests/e2e.sh, scripts/run_e2e.sh) behind four subcommands:
6	
7	    ./hsim build [--what TARGET]
8	    ./hsim run <elf-path> --mode csr|pc|icount|slice [--verbose]
9	    ./hsim test [--filter REGEX] [--mode csr|pc|both]
10	    ./hsim list <fixtures|demos|modes>
11	    ./hsim doctor
12	    ./hsim demo <T1..T7|short-name> [-- KEY=VAL ...]
13	    ./hsim profile <elf> --slice N --icount M -o BBV
14	    ./hsim cluster <bbv> --max-k K --simpts P --weights P
15	    ./hsim archive --state S --mmap M --elf E -o snap/N
16	    ./hsim replay snap/N [--resume-with vsim|qemu]
17	    ./hsim estimate <elf> --slice N --icount M --max-k K
18	
19	Python 3 stdlib only; no pip deps.
20	"""
21	from __future__ import annotations
22	
23	import argparse
24	import os
25	import re
26	import shlex
27	import shutil
28	import subprocess
29	import sys
30	import tempfile
31	import time
32	from pathlib import Path
33	
34	
35	REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
36	
37	
38	# --- F1: list ---------------------------------------------------------------
39	
40	# The 4 switching modes. Authoritative source: docs/USER_GUIDE.md section 3 and
41	# docs/switching_modes_tutorial.md. Kept here so `./hsim list modes` does not
42	# need to grep the docs at runtime. CSR/PC profile a kernel; icount/SimPoint
43	# sample the whole program. (bbv / slice / archive / replay are SimPoint stages,
44	# not top-level modes; the end-of-program exit is the run tail.)
45	# Tuple: (key, profiles, how-to-run + note).
46	MODES = [
47	    ("csr",      "kernel",        "csrwi 0x7C0,{0,1} markers in source (default); ./hsim run --mode csr"),
48	    ("pc",       "kernel",        "PC / symbol address, no source edit; ./hsim run --mode pc"),
49	    ("icount",   "whole program", "single boundary at N retired insns, CSR-less; ./hsim run --mode icount"),
50	    ("simpoint", "whole program", "clustered representative slices -> whole-program cycle estimate; ./hsim estimate"),
51	]
52	
53	
54	def parse_fixtures(makefile: Path) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
55	    """Extract fixture names + family from tests/fixtures/Makefile.
56	
57	    Returns rows (name, family) in stable, family-grouped order. Family is
58	    the variable they came from (RT_FIXTURES, RT_C_FIXTURES, ...).
59	    """
60	    text = makefile.read_text()
61	    rows: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
62	    # Variable definitions look like:
63	    #   RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_abi_aliases \
64	    #                  rt_long_roi
65	    # We capture everything up to a non-continuation newline.
66	    var_pattern = re.compile(
67	        r"^(?P<var>[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*:?=\s*(?P<body>(?:[^\n]*\\\n)*[^\n]*)$",
68	        re.MULTILINE,
69	    )
70	    interesting = {
71	        "RT_FIXTURES":      "asm",
72	        "RT_C_FIXTURES":    "c",
73	        "RT_C_V_FIXTURES":  "c+rvv",
74	        "PROBE_V_FIXTURES": "probe",
75	    }
76	    seen: set[str] = set()
77	    for m in var_pattern.finditer(text):
78	        var = m.group("var")
79	        if var not in interesting:
80	            continue
81	        family = interesting[var]
82	        body = m.group("body").replace("\\\n", " ")
83	        for name in body.split():
84	            if name and name not in seen:
85	                rows.append((name, family))
86	                seen.add(name)
87	    # Pick up the legacy hand-listed ELF targets.
88	    for name in ("handoff_roundtrip",):
89	        if name not in seen:
90	            rows.append((name, "asm"))
91	            seen.add(name)
92	    return rows
93	
94	
95	def list_fixtures() -> int:
96	    makefile = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures" / "Makefile"
97	    if not makefile.is_file():
98	        print(f"hsim: missing {makefile}", file=sys.stderr)
99	        return 2
100	    rows = parse_fixtures(makefile)
101	    width = max(len(name) for name, _ in rows)
102	    print(f"{'FIXTURE'.ljust(width)}  FAMILY")
103	    for name, family in rows:
104	        print(f"{name.ljust(width)}  {family}")
105	    return 0
106	
107	
108	def list_demos() -> int:
109	    demo_dir = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "demos"
110	    if not demo_dir.is_dir():
111	        print(f"hsim: missing {demo_dir}", file=sys.stderr)
112	        return 2
113	    width = max(len(f"demo_{short}") for _t, short, _m in _DEMO_ORDER)
114	    print("HEADLINE demos (one per switching mode):")
115	    for _tid, short, mode in _DEMO_ORDER:
116	        if mode != "simpoint-stage":
117	            print(f"  {('demo_' + short).ljust(width)}  mode: {mode}")
118	    print("SimPoint stages (run inside SimPoint mode; not headline modes):")
119	    for _tid, short, mode in _DEMO_ORDER:
120	        if mode == "simpoint-stage":
121	            print(f"  {('demo_' + short).ljust(width)}")
122	    return 0
123	
124	
125	def list_modes() -> int:
126	    width_key = max(len(m[0]) for m in MODES)
127	    width_tgt = max(len(m[1]) for m in MODES)
128	    print(f"{'MODE'.ljust(width_key)}  {'PROFILES'.ljust(width_tgt)}  HOW TO RUN / NOTES")
129	    for key, target, desc in MODES:
130	        print(f"{key.ljust(width_key)}  {target.ljust(width_tgt)}  {desc}")
131	    return 0
132	
133	
134	def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
135	    return {
136	        "fixtures": list_fixtures,
137	        "demos":    list_demos,
138	        "modes":    list_modes,
139	    }[args.target]()
140	
141	
142	# --- F2: build --------------------------------------------------------------
143	
144	# Each target maps to a list of subprocess argv lists. We delegate to the
145	# existing scripts (setup.sh, scripts/build_*.sh, Makefiles) -- no logic
146	# duplicated here.
147	def _build_steps(target: str) -> list[list[str]]:
148	    qemu     = ["bash", "scripts/build_qemu.sh"]
149	    vsim     = ["bash", "scripts/build_vsim.sh"]
150	    plugin   = ["make", "-C", "qemu_plugin", "QEMU_ROOT=./QEMU"]
151	    simpoint = ["bash", "scripts/build_simpoint.sh"]
152	    fixtures = ["make", "-C", "tests/fixtures"]
153	    setup    = ["bash", "setup.sh"]
154	    return {
155	        "all":      [setup, fixtures],
156	        "qemu":     [qemu],
157	        "vsim":     [vsim],
158	        "plugin":   [plugin],
159	        "simpoint": [simpoint],
160	        "fixtures": [fixtures],
161	    }[target]
162	
163	
164	def cmd_build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
165	    try:
166	        steps = _build_steps(args.what)
167	    except KeyError:
168	        print(f"hsim: unknown build target: {args.what}", file=sys.stderr)
169	        return 2
170	    for argv in steps:
171	        line = shlex.join(argv)
172	        if args.dry_run:
173	            print(line)
174	            continue
175	        print(f"[hsim] {line}")
176	        rc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT).returncode
177	        if rc != 0:
178	            print(f"hsim: build step failed (rc={rc}): {line}", file=sys.stderr)
179	            return rc
180	    return 0
181	
182	
183	# --- F3: run ----------------------------------------------------------------
184	
185	# Default build-artifact locations. Honored as env-var overrides so the
186	# F3 RED test can simulate a missing vsim binary without disturbing the
187	# real one.
188	_DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS = {
189	    "vsim":   REPO_ROOT / "verilator" / "build" / "sim_ax45mpv_premium",
190	    "qemu":   REPO_ROOT / "build" / "qemu" / "qemu-system-riscv64",
191	    "plugin": REPO_ROOT / "qemu_plugin" / "libhybrid_handoff.so",
192	}
193	_ARTIFACT_ENV = {"vsim": "VSIM_BIN", "qemu": "VSIM_QEMU", "plugin": "VSIM_PLUGIN"}
194	
195	
196	def _resolve_artifacts() -> dict[str, Path]:
197	    return {
198	        label: Path(os.environ.get(_ARTIFACT_ENV[label]) or default)
199	        for label, default in _DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS.items()
200	    }
201	
202	
203	def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
204	    elf = Path(args.elf)
205	    if not elf.is_absolute():
206	        elf = (Path.cwd() / elf).resolve()
207	    if not elf.is_file():
208	        print(f"hsim: ELF not found: {args.elf}", file=sys.stderr)
209	        return 2
210	
211	    artifacts = _resolve_artifacts()
212	    for label, path in artifacts.items():
213	        if not path.is_file():
214	            print(f"hsim: {label} not built -- run ./hsim build", file=sys.stderr)
215	            return 2
216	
217	    if args.mode in ("csr", "pc"):
218	        return _run_via_e2e(elf, artifacts, args)
219	    if args.mode == "icount":
220	        return _run_drain_pair(
221	            elf, artifacts,
222	            plugin_extras=(f"icount={args.qemu_icount}",),
223	            vsim_icount=args.vsim_icount,
224	            label="icount",
225	            mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
226	        )
227	    if args.mode == "slice":
228	        return _run_drain_pair(
229	            elf, artifacts,
230	            plugin_extras=(
231	                f"slice={args.slice}",
232	                f"slice_at={args.slice_at}",
233	                f"icount={args.qemu_icount}",
234	            ),
235	            vsim_icount=args.vsim_icount,
236	            label="slice",
237	            mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
238	        )
239	    print(f"hsim: unsupported mode: {args.mode}", file=sys.stderr)
240	    return 2
241	
242	
243	def _run_via_e2e(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
244	                 args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
245	    """csr/pc path: delegate to tests/e2e.sh (unchanged from F3)."""
246	    env = os.environ.copy()
247	    env["FIXTURE"]      = elf.stem
248	    env["TRIGGER_MODE"] = args.mode
249	    env["VSIM_ELF"]     = str(elf)
250	    env["VSIM_BIN"]     = str(artifacts["vsim"])
251	    env["VSIM_QEMU"]    = str(artifacts["qemu"])
252	    env["VSIM_PLUGIN"]  = str(artifacts["plugin"])
253	    # pc mode: forward the ROI boundaries (symbol name or 0x address). When
254	    # unset, tests/e2e.sh falls back to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
255	    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers.
256	    if args.mode == "pc":
257	        if args.roi_start:
258	            env["ROI_START"] = args.roi_start
259	        if args.roi_end:
260	            env["ROI_END"] = args.roi_end
261	
262	    cmd = ["bash", str(REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "e2e.sh")]
263	    if args.verbose:
264	        roi = ""
265	        if args.mode == "pc":
266	            roi = (f" ROI_START={env.get('ROI_START', '_hybrid_enter_pc')}"
267	                   f" ROI_END={env.get('ROI_END', '_hybrid_exit_pc')}")
268	        print(f"[hsim] FIXTURE={env['FIXTURE']} TRIGGER_MODE={env['TRIGGER_MODE']} "
269	              f"VSIM_ELF={env['VSIM_ELF']}{roi}", flush=True)
270	        print(f"[hsim] exec: {shlex.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
271	    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, env=env).returncode
272	
273	
274	# F11: inline QEMU + vsim drain pair for --mode icount and --mode slice.
275	# e2e.sh only knows about csr/pc triggers; these CSR-less modes need a
276	# direct two-spawn path. Mirrors demo_icount_roundtrip.sh +
277	# demo_slice_consume_roundtrip.sh: both drain at exit code 200, vsim
278	# uses --hybrid-icount as the exit trigger.
279	_VSIM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S = 120
280	
281	
282	def _vsim_drain_argv(vsim: Path, elf: Path, state_in: Path,
283	                     state_out: Path, hybrid_icount: int) -> list[str]:
284	    """vsim drain argv with --hybrid-icount trigger.
285	
286	    No --shared-mem-* flags: the CSR-less workloads exercised by
287	    --mode icount and --mode slice (e.g. icount_spin.elf) re-derive
288	    their tight loop from the resumed state alone, matching
289	    demo_icount_roundtrip.sh and demo_slice_consume_roundtrip.sh.
290	    """
291	    return [
292	        str(vsim), str(elf),
293	        "--resume-from-qemu", str(state_in),
294	        "--handoff-out", str(state_out),
295	        "--hybrid-icount", str(hybrid_icount),
296	    ]
297	
298	
299	def _run_drain_pair(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
300	                    plugin_extras: tuple[str, ...],
301	                    vsim_icount: int, label: str,
302	                    mmap_size: int) -> int:
303	    """Two-step QEMU + vsim drain round-trip.
304	
305	    QEMU drains at its plugin trigger -> state file. vsim resumes from
306	    that state, drains after `vsim_icount` retired insns. Both spawns
307	    must exit `_QEMU_DRAIN_RC` (200). Used by --mode icount/slice.
308	    """
309	    try:
310	        shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
311	            mmap_size, prefix=f"hsim-{label}-shm.",
312	        )
313	    except Exception as exc:
314	        print(f"hsim: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
315	        return 2
316	
317	    state_q_fd, state_q_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-qstate.")
318	    os.close(state_q_fd)
319	    state_q = Path(state_q_name)
320	
321	    state_v_fd, state_v_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-vstate.")
322	    os.close(state_v_fd)
323	    state_v = Path(state_v_name)
324	
325	    try:
326	        qemu_argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
327	            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
328	            shm_path, mmap_size, state_q,
329	            plugin_extras=plugin_extras,
330	        )
331	        print(f"[hsim {label} 1/2] QEMU drain ({','.join(plugin_extras)})",
332	              flush=True)
333	        proc = subprocess.run(
334	            qemu_argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
335	            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
336	            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
337	        )
338	        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
339	            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
340	            print(f"hsim: QEMU {label} expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
341	                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
342	            for line in tail:
343	                print(line, file=sys.stderr)

1059	def _run_drain_at_exit_profile(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],

1066	    The plugin's drain_at_exit=1 mode counts every retired insn via a
1067	    per-insn exec cb and overrides the drained state file's `minstret`
1068	    field with that count (QEMU's PMU minstret is host-tick-derived on
1069	    system-mode without -icount, which is why we use the plugin counter).
1070	    """

1072	        mmap_size, prefix="hsim-profile-shm.",
1073	    )
1074	    state_fd, state_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hsim-profile-state.")
1075	    os.close(state_fd)
1076	    state_out = Path(state_name)
1077	    try:
1078	        argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
1079	            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
1080	            shm_path, mmap_size, state_out,
1081	            plugin_extras=(

1088	            argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
1089	            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
1090	            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
1091	        )
1092	        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
1093	            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
1094	            print(f"hsim: QEMU profile expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
1095	                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)

1102	            return 1, 0

1116	            return 1, 0
1117	
1118	        print(f"profile: {rows} BBV rows -> {bbv} (N_total={n_total})")
1119	        return 0, n_total
1120	    finally:
1121	        for p in (shm_path, state_out):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""hsim - end-user entry point for the Andes hybrid simulator.

Single-file driver. Wraps the developer-grade scripts (setup.sh,
tests/e2e.sh, scripts/run_e2e.sh) behind four subcommands:

    ./hsim build [--what TARGET]
    ./hsim run <elf-path> --mode csr|pc|icount|slice [--verbose]
    ./hsim test [--filter REGEX] [--mode csr|pc|both]
    ./hsim list <fixtures|demos|modes>
    ./hsim doctor
    ./hsim demo <T1..T7|short-name> [-- KEY=VAL ...]
    ./hsim profile <elf> --slice N --icount M -o BBV
    ./hsim cluster <bbv> --max-k K --simpts P --weights P
    ./hsim archive --state S --mmap M --elf E -o snap/N
    ./hsim replay snap/N [--resume-with vsim|qemu]
    ./hsim estimate <elf> --slice N --icount M --max-k K

Python 3 stdlib only; no pip deps.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


# --- F1: list ---------------------------------------------------------------

# The 4 switching modes. Authoritative source: docs/USER_GUIDE.md section 3 and
# docs/switching_modes_tutorial.md. Kept here so `./hsim list modes` does not
# need to grep the docs at runtime. CSR/PC profile a kernel; icount/SimPoint
# sample the whole program. (bbv / slice / archive / replay are SimPoint stages,
# not top-level modes; the end-of-program exit is the run tail.)
# Tuple: (key, profiles, how-to-run + note).
MODES = [
    ("csr",      "kernel",        "csrwi 0x7C0,{0,1} markers in source (default); ./hsim run --mode csr"),
    ("pc",       "kernel",        "PC / symbol address, no source edit; ./hsim run --mode pc"),
    ("icount",   "whole program", "single boundary at N retired insns, CSR-less; ./hsim run --mode icount"),
    ("simpoint", "whole program", "clustered representative slices -> whole-program cycle estimate; ./hsim estimate"),
]


def parse_fixtures(makefile: Path) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Extract fixture names + family from tests/fixtures/Makefile.

    Returns rows (name, family) in stable, family-grouped order. Family is
    the variable they came from (RT_FIXTURES, RT_C_FIXTURES, ...).
    """
    text = makefile.read_text()
    rows: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    # Variable definitions look like:
    #   RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_abi_aliases \
    #                  rt_long_roi
    # We capture everything up to a non-continuation newline.
    var_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^(?P<var>[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*:?=\s*(?P<body>(?:[^\n]*\\\n)*[^\n]*)$",
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    interesting = {
        "RT_FIXTURES":      "asm",
        "RT_C_FIXTURES":    "c",
        "RT_C_V_FIXTURES":  "c+rvv",
        "PROBE_V_FIXTURES": "probe",
    }
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for m in var_pattern.finditer(text):
        var = m.group("var")
        if var not in interesting:
            continue
        family = interesting[var]
        body = m.group("body").replace("\\\n", " ")
        for name in body.split():
            if name and name not in seen:
                rows.append((name, family))
                seen.add(name)
    # Pick up the legacy hand-listed ELF targets.
    for name in ("handoff_roundtrip",):
        if name not in seen:
            rows.append((name, "asm"))
            seen.add(name)
    return rows


def list_fixtures() -> int:
    makefile = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures" / "Makefile"
    if not makefile.is_file():
        print(f"hsim: missing {makefile}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    rows = parse_fixtures(makefile)
    width = max(len(name) for name, _ in rows)
    print(f"{'FIXTURE'.ljust(width)}  FAMILY")
    for name, family in rows:
        print(f"{name.ljust(width)}  {family}")
    return 0


def list_demos() -> int:
    demo_dir = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "demos"
    if not demo_dir.is_dir():
        print(f"hsim: missing {demo_dir}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    width = max(len(f"demo_{short}") for _t, short, _m in _DEMO_ORDER)
    print("HEADLINE demos (one per switching mode):")
    for _tid, short, mode in _DEMO_ORDER:
        if mode != "simpoint-stage":
            print(f"  {('demo_' + short).ljust(width)}  mode: {mode}")
    print("SimPoint stages (run inside SimPoint mode; not headline modes):")
    for _tid, short, mode in _DEMO_ORDER:
        if mode == "simpoint-stage":
            print(f"  {('demo_' + short).ljust(width)}")
    return 0


def list_modes() -> int:
    width_key = max(len(m[0]) for m in MODES)
    width_tgt = max(len(m[1]) for m in MODES)
    print(f"{'MODE'.ljust(width_key)}  {'PROFILES'.ljust(width_tgt)}  HOW TO RUN / NOTES")
    for key, target, desc in MODES:
        print(f"{key.ljust(width_key)}  {target.ljust(width_tgt)}  {desc}")
    return 0


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return {
        "fixtures": list_fixtures,
        "demos":    list_demos,
        "modes":    list_modes,
    }[args.target]()


# --- F2: build --------------------------------------------------------------

# Each target maps to a list of subprocess argv lists. We delegate to the
# existing scripts (setup.sh, scripts/build_*.sh, Makefiles) -- no logic
# duplicated here.
def _build_steps(target: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    qemu     = ["bash", "scripts/build_qemu.sh"]
    vsim     = ["bash", "scripts/build_vsim.sh"]
    plugin   = ["make", "-C", "qemu_plugin", "QEMU_ROOT=./QEMU"]
    simpoint = ["bash", "scripts/build_simpoint.sh"]
    fixtures = ["make", "-C", "tests/fixtures"]
    setup    = ["bash", "setup.sh"]
    return {
        "all":      [setup, fixtures],
        "qemu":     [qemu],
        "vsim":     [vsim],
        "plugin":   [plugin],
        "simpoint": [simpoint],
        "fixtures": [fixtures],
    }[target]


def cmd_build(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        steps = _build_steps(args.what)
    except KeyError:
        print(f"hsim: unknown build target: {args.what}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    for argv in steps:
        line = shlex.join(argv)
        if args.dry_run:
            print(line)
            continue
        print(f"[hsim] {line}")
        rc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT).returncode
        if rc != 0:
            print(f"hsim: build step failed (rc={rc}): {line}", file=sys.stderr)
            return rc
    return 0


# --- F3: run ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Default build-artifact locations. Honored as env-var overrides so the
# F3 RED test can simulate a missing vsim binary without disturbing the
# real one.
_DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS = {
    "vsim":   REPO_ROOT / "verilator" / "build" / "sim_ax45mpv_premium",
    "qemu":   REPO_ROOT / "build" / "qemu" / "qemu-system-riscv64",
    "plugin": REPO_ROOT / "qemu_plugin" / "libhybrid_handoff.so",
}
_ARTIFACT_ENV = {"vsim": "VSIM_BIN", "qemu": "VSIM_QEMU", "plugin": "VSIM_PLUGIN"}


def _resolve_artifacts() -> dict[str, Path]:
    return {
        label: Path(os.environ.get(_ARTIFACT_ENV[label]) or default)
        for label, default in _DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS.items()
    }


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    elf = Path(args.elf)
    if not elf.is_absolute():
        elf = (Path.cwd() / elf).resolve()
    if not elf.is_file():
        print(f"hsim: ELF not found: {args.elf}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    artifacts = _resolve_artifacts()
    for label, path in artifacts.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            print(f"hsim: {label} not built -- run ./hsim build", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

    if args.mode in ("csr", "pc"):
        return _run_via_e2e(elf, artifacts, args)
    if args.mode == "icount":
        return _run_drain_pair(
            elf, artifacts,
            plugin_extras=(f"icount={args.qemu_icount}",),
            vsim_icount=args.vsim_icount,
            label="icount",
            mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
        )
    if args.mode == "slice":
        return _run_drain_pair(
            elf, artifacts,
            plugin_extras=(
                f"slice={args.slice}",
                f"slice_at={args.slice_at}",
                f"icount={args.qemu_icount}",
            ),
            vsim_icount=args.vsim_icount,
            label="slice",
            mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
        )
    print(f"hsim: unsupported mode: {args.mode}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


def _run_via_e2e(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
                 args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """csr/pc path: delegate to tests/e2e.sh (unchanged from F3)."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["FIXTURE"]      = elf.stem
    env["TRIGGER_MODE"] = args.mode
    env["VSIM_ELF"]     = str(elf)
    env["VSIM_BIN"]     = str(artifacts["vsim"])
    env["VSIM_QEMU"]    = str(artifacts["qemu"])
    env["VSIM_PLUGIN"]  = str(artifacts["plugin"])
    # pc mode: forward the ROI boundaries (symbol name or 0x address). When
    # unset, tests/e2e.sh falls back to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers.
    if args.mode == "pc":
        if args.roi_start:
            env["ROI_START"] = args.roi_start
        if args.roi_end:
            env["ROI_END"] = args.roi_end

    cmd = ["bash", str(REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "e2e.sh")]
    if args.verbose:
        roi = ""
        if args.mode == "pc":
            roi = (f" ROI_START={env.get('ROI_START', '_hybrid_enter_pc')}"
                   f" ROI_END={env.get('ROI_END', '_hybrid_exit_pc')}")
        print(f"[hsim] FIXTURE={env['FIXTURE']} TRIGGER_MODE={env['TRIGGER_MODE']} "
              f"VSIM_ELF={env['VSIM_ELF']}{roi}", flush=True)
        print(f"[hsim] exec: {shlex.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, env=env).returncode


# F11: inline QEMU + vsim drain pair for --mode icount and --mode slice.
# e2e.sh only knows about csr/pc triggers; these CSR-less modes need a
# direct two-spawn path. Mirrors demo_icount_roundtrip.sh +
# demo_slice_consume_roundtrip.sh: both drain at exit code 200, vsim
# uses --hybrid-icount as the exit trigger.
_VSIM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S = 120


def _vsim_drain_argv(vsim: Path, elf: Path, state_in: Path,
                     state_out: Path, hybrid_icount: int) -> list[str]:
    """vsim drain argv with --hybrid-icount trigger.

    No --shared-mem-* flags: the CSR-less workloads exercised by
    --mode icount and --mode slice (e.g. icount_spin.elf) re-derive
    their tight loop from the resumed state alone, matching
    demo_icount_roundtrip.sh and demo_slice_consume_roundtrip.sh.
    """
    return [
        str(vsim), str(elf),
        "--resume-from-qemu", str(state_in),
        "--handoff-out", str(state_out),
        "--hybrid-icount", str(hybrid_icount),
    ]


def _run_drain_pair(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
                    plugin_extras: tuple[str, ...],
                    vsim_icount: int, label: str,
                    mmap_size: int) -> int:
    """Two-step QEMU + vsim drain round-trip.

    QEMU drains at its plugin trigger -> state file. vsim resumes from
    that state, drains after `vsim_icount` retired insns. Both spawns
    must exit `_QEMU_DRAIN_RC` (200). Used by --mode icount/slice.
    """
    try:
        shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
            mmap_size, prefix=f"hsim-{label}-shm.",
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"hsim: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    state_q_fd, state_q_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-qstate.")
    os.close(state_q_fd)
    state_q = Path(state_q_name)

    state_v_fd, state_v_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-vstate.")
    os.close(state_v_fd)
    state_v = Path(state_v_name)

    try:
        qemu_argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
            shm_path, mmap_size, state_q,
            plugin_extras=plugin_extras,
        )
        print(f"[hsim {label} 1/2] QEMU drain ({','.join(plugin_extras)})",
              flush=True)
        proc = subprocess.run(
            qemu_argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
            print(f"hsim: QEMU {label} expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
            for line in tail:
                print(line, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

        print(f"[hsim {label} 2/2] vsim --hybrid-icount {vsim_icount} drain",
              flush=True)
        vsim_argv = _vsim_drain_argv(
            artifacts["vsim"], elf, state_q, state_v, vsim_icount,
        )
        proc = subprocess.run(
            vsim_argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_VSIM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
            print(f"hsim: vsim {label} expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
            for line in tail:
                print(line, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

        mc_q = _read_state_mcycle(state_q)
        mc_v = _read_state_mcycle(state_v)
        print(f"[{label} window_cycles] {mc_v - mc_q}  "
              f"(vsim mcycle={mc_v} - qemu mcycle={mc_q})")
        print(f"PASS: --mode {label} ({elf.name})")
        return 0
    finally:
        for p in (shm_path, state_q, state_v):
            try:
                p.unlink()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass


# --- F4: test ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Default JOBS cap. The 128-core dev host saturates if scripts/run_e2e.sh's
# default (~nproc) is used, so we pin to 8. --jobs N overrides.
_DEFAULT_JOBS = 8


def _summarize_results(log_dir: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int, list[Path]]:
    results = log_dir / "results.tsv"
    p = f = s = 0
    failed_logs: list[Path] = []
    if not results.is_file():
        return p, f, s, failed_logs
    for line in results.read_text().splitlines():
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) < 3:
            continue
        mode, name, status = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
        if status == "PASS":
            p += 1
        elif status == "FAIL":
            f += 1
            failed_logs.append(log_dir / f"{mode}--{name}.log")
        elif status == "SKIP":
            s += 1

# --- F7: doctor (env-health diagnoser) --------------------------------------

# Each check returns rows of (name, status, detail). Statuses:
#   PASS - the resource exists and is usable.
#   FAIL - missing/broken; exit code 1 if any present.
#   WARN - degraded but does not block build/test.
#   INFO - informational (host facts), never affects exit code.
_DoctorRow = tuple[str, str, str]


def _read_hybrid_toolchain() -> str | None:
    """Locate HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN: env first, then config.env fallback."""
    tc = os.environ.get("HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN")
    if tc:
        return tc
    cfg = REPO_ROOT / "config.env"
    if not cfg.is_file():
        return None
    pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN\s*=\s*(.+?)\s*$")
    for line in cfg.read_text().splitlines():
        m = pattern.match(line)
        if m:
            return m.group(1).strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    return None


def _doctor_artifacts() -> list[_DoctorRow]:
    rows: list[_DoctorRow] = []
    for label, path in _resolve_artifacts().items():
        if path.is_file():
            rows.append((label, "PASS", str(path)))
        else:
            rows.append((label, "FAIL",
                         f"missing {path} -- run ./hsim build"))
    simpoint = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "simpoint" / "bin" / "simpoint"
    if simpoint.is_file():
        rows.append(("simpoint", "PASS", str(simpoint)))
    else:
        rows.append(("simpoint", "FAIL",
                     f"missing {simpoint} -- run ./hsim build --what simpoint"))
    fix_dir = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures"
    elfs = sorted(fix_dir.glob("*.elf")) if fix_dir.is_dir() else []
    if elfs:
        rows.append(("fixtures", "PASS", f"{len(elfs)} ELFs in {fix_dir}"))
    else:
        rows.append(("fixtures", "FAIL",
                     f"no *.elf in {fix_dir} -- run make -C tests/fixtures"))
    return rows


def _doctor_submodules() -> list[_DoctorRow]:
    markers = [
        ("QEMU/",           REPO_ROOT / "QEMU" / "configure"),
        ("verilator/",      REPO_ROOT / "verilator" / "CMakeLists.txt"),
        ("tools/simpoint/", REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "simpoint" / "Makefile"),
    ]
    rows: list[_DoctorRow] = []
    for name, marker in markers:
        if marker.is_file():
            rows.append((name, "PASS", str(marker.relative_to(REPO_ROOT))))
        else:
            rows.append((name, "FAIL",
                         f"missing {marker} -- "
                         f"run 'git submodule update --init --recursive'"))
    return rows


def _doctor_toolchain() -> list[_DoctorRow]:
    rows: list[_DoctorRow] = []
    for tool in ("ninja", "make", "podman"):
        found = shutil.which(tool)
        if found:
            rows.append((tool, "PASS", found))
        else:
            severity = "WARN" if tool == "podman" else "FAIL"
            hint = {
                "ninja":  "needed by ./hsim build of QEMU",
                "make":   "needed by ./hsim build of fixtures + simpoint",
                "podman": "needed by ./hsim build of vsim (or docker shim)",
            }[tool]
            rows.append((tool, severity, f"not on PATH -- {hint}"))
    tc = _read_hybrid_toolchain()
    if not tc:
        rows.append(("HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN", "WARN",
                     "not set -- needed for fixture build "
                     "(see config.env)"))
    else:
        gcc = Path(tc) / "bin" / "riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc"
        if gcc.is_file():
            rows.append(("riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc", "PASS", str(gcc)))
        else:
            rows.append(("riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc", "FAIL",
                         f"missing {gcc} -- check HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN={tc}"))
    return rows


def _doctor_runtime() -> list[_DoctorRow]:
    rows: list[_DoctorRow] = []
    nproc = os.cpu_count() or 1
    rows.append(("nproc", "INFO", str(nproc)))
    shm = Path("/dev/shm")
    if shm.is_dir():
        free_gb = shutil.disk_usage(shm).free // (1024 ** 3)
        status = "PASS" if free_gb >= 4 else "WARN"
        rows.append(("/dev/shm free", status, f"{free_gb} GB"))
    else:
        rows.append(("/dev/shm", "WARN",
                     "not present -- e2e fixtures will fall back to $TMPDIR"))
    suggested = min(nproc, _DEFAULT_JOBS)
    rows.append(("JOBS suggestion", "INFO",
                 f"{suggested} (default cap = {_DEFAULT_JOBS})"))
    return rows


def cmd_doctor(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    sections: list[tuple[str, list[_DoctorRow]]] = [
        ("artifacts",  _doctor_artifacts()),
        ("submodules", _doctor_submodules()),
        ("toolchain",  _doctor_toolchain()),
        ("runtime",    _doctor_runtime()),
    ]
    name_width = max(len(name)
                     for _, rows in sections
                     for name, _, _ in rows)
    totals = {"PASS": 0, "FAIL": 0, "WARN": 0, "INFO": 0}
    for title, rows in sections:
        print(f"{title}:")
        for name, status, detail in rows:
            totals[status] = totals.get(status, 0) + 1
            print(f"  [{status:<4}] {name.ljust(name_width)}  {detail}")
        print()
    print(f"Summary: {totals['PASS']} PASS, {totals['FAIL']} FAIL, "
          f"{totals['WARN']} WARN")
    return 1 if totals["FAIL"] > 0 else 0

_DEMO_ORDER = [
    ("T1", "csr_oneshot",             "csr"),
    ("T2", "pc_oneshot",              "pc"),
    ("T3", "icount_roundtrip",        "icount"),
    ("T4", "bbv_profile",             "simpoint-stage"),

    ("T7", "simpoint_loop",           "simpoint"),
]


def _demo_script(short: str) -> Path:
    return REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "demos" / f"demo_{short}.sh"


def _resolve_demo(selector: str) -> tuple[str, Path] | tuple[None, None]:
    """Map T-id, short name, or `demo_<short>` to (short, script-path).

    Returns (None, None) if no match. The triple form lets users copy-paste
    from `./hsim list demos` (which emits `demo_<short>`) too.
    """
    sel = selector.strip()
    for tid, short, _mode in _DEMO_ORDER:
        if sel == tid or sel == short or sel == f"demo_{short}":
            return short, _demo_script(short)
    return None, None


def _parse_demo_passthrough(items: list[str]) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    """Parse `-- KEY=VAL KEY=VAL ...` trailing args. Returns None on bad form."""
    env_extra: dict[str, str] = {}
    for it in items or []:
        if it == "--":
            continue
        if "=" not in it or it.startswith("="):
            return None
        k, v = it.split("=", 1)
        env_extra[k] = v
    return env_extra


def cmd_demo(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if not args.selector:
        print(
            "hsim: missing demo selector -- run ./hsim list demos",
            file=sys.stderr,

    short, script = _resolve_demo(args.selector)
    if script is None:
        print(
            f"hsim: unknown demo: {args.selector} -- "
            "run ./hsim list demos (or use T1..T7)",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 2
    if not script.is_file():
        print(f"hsim: demo script not found: {script}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    env_extra = _parse_demo_passthrough(args.extras)
    if env_extra is None:
        print(

            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 2

    artifacts = _resolve_artifacts()
    for label, path in artifacts.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            print(f"hsim: {label} not built -- run ./hsim build", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["VSIM_BIN"]    = str(artifacts["vsim"])
    env["VSIM_QEMU"]   = str(artifacts["qemu"])
    env["VSIM_PLUGIN"] = str(artifacts["plugin"])
    # Demos that shell out to RISC-V toolchain binaries (nm, objdump for the

    tc = _read_hybrid_toolchain()
    if tc and "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN" not in env:
        env["HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"] = tc
    env.update(env_extra)

    cmd = ["bash", str(script)]
    if args.dry_run:
        for k, v in env_extra.items():
            print(f"{k}={v}")
        print(f"exec: {shlex.join(cmd)}")
        return 0
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT, env=env).returncode

# SimPoint clustering binary. Path is fixed by tools/simpoint/Makefile;
# kept as a constant here so a future build-output relocation only edits
# one place. No env override -- VSIM_QEMU/_PLUGIN/_BIN cover the hybrid
# artifacts; SimPoint is a separate, host-only tool with no e2e knob.
_SIMPOINT_BIN = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "simpoint" / "bin" / "simpoint"

# Profile pass exit contract: the plugin drains at the icount limit and
# QEMU exits 200 (drain code). Same contract used by demo_bbv_profile.sh
# and the orchestrator's runner._qemu_drain.
_QEMU_DRAIN_RC = 200
_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S = 30        # matches demo_bbv_profile.sh


def _load_hsim_shm():
    """Lazy-load tools/hsim_shm with parse_size / allocate / NoSpaceError."""
    tools_dir = str(REPO_ROOT / "tools")
    if tools_dir not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, tools_dir)
    import hsim_shm
    return hsim_shm


def _parse_mmap_size(spec: str) -> int:
    """argparse type= callable; lazy-wraps hsim_shm.parse_size."""
    return _load_hsim_shm().parse_size(spec)


def _qemu_drain_argv(qemu: Path, elf: Path, plugin: Path,
                     shm_path: Path, shm_size: int, state_out: Path,
                     plugin_extras: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> list[str]:
    """Build the QEMU + plugin drain argv shared by M3/M4/M5 paths.

    `plugin_extras` are `key=value` strings appended after `outfile=`.
    Same base flags as orchestrator.spawn.qemu_drain_argv (the upstream
    source of truth); inlined here because that helper bakes only
    `outfile=` and does not yet thread plugin params through
    `trigger.params` (deferred orchestrator refactor; see
    driver_ROADMAP.md).
    """
    mem_obj = (
        f"memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,"
        f"mem-path={shm_path},size={shm_size}"
    )
    plugin_pairs = [f"outfile={state_out}", *plugin_extras]
    return [
        str(qemu),
        "-object", mem_obj,
        "-machine", "andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem",
        "-cpu", "andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512",
        "-nographic",
        "-semihosting-config", "enable=on,target=native",
        "-bios", str(elf),
        "-plugin", f"{plugin}," + ",".join(plugin_pairs),
    ]


def _qemu_profile_argv(qemu: Path, elf: Path, plugin: Path,
                       shm_path: Path, shm_size: int, state_out: Path,
                       bbv_out: Path, slice_n: int, icount: int) -> list[str]:
    """M4 profile pass argv: `_qemu_drain_argv` + the BBV plugin extras."""
    return _qemu_drain_argv(
        qemu, elf, plugin, shm_path, shm_size, state_out,
        plugin_extras=(
            f"bbv_out={bbv_out}",
            f"slice={slice_n}",
            f"icount={icount}",
        ),
    )


def cmd_profile(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    elf = Path(args.elf)
    if not elf.is_absolute():
        elf = (Path.cwd() / elf).resolve()
    if not elf.is_file():
        print(f"hsim: ELF not found: {args.elf}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    artifacts = _resolve_artifacts()
    # Profile pass uses qemu + plugin only; vsim is not invoked.
    for label in ("qemu", "plugin"):
        if not artifacts[label].is_file():
            print(f"hsim: {label} not built -- run ./hsim build",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

    bbv = Path(args.output)
    bbv.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    try:
        shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
            args.mmap_size, prefix="hsim-profile-shm.",
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"hsim: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    state_fd, state_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hsim-profile-state.")
    os.close(state_fd)
    state_out = Path(state_name)

    try:
        argv = _qemu_profile_argv(
            qemu=artifacts["qemu"], elf=elf, plugin=artifacts["plugin"],
            shm_path=shm_path, shm_size=args.mmap_size, state_out=state_out,
            bbv_out=bbv, slice_n=args.slice, icount=args.icount,
        )

        if args.dry_run:
            print(f"exec: {shlex.join(argv)}")
            return 0

        proc = subprocess.run(
            argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
            print(f"hsim: QEMU profile expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
            for line in tail:
                print(line, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

        if not bbv.is_file() or bbv.stat().st_size == 0:
            print(f"hsim: profile produced empty BBV: {bbv}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        rows = sum(1 for _ in bbv.open())
        print(f"profile: {rows} BBV rows -> {bbv}")
        return 0
    finally:
        for p in (shm_path, state_out):
            try:
                p.unlink()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass

# --- F12: estimate (SimPoint cycle aggregator) -----------------------------

# End-to-end: M4 profile (F9) -> SimPoint cluster (F9) -> per-phase
# QEMU+vsim drain (mirrors --mode slice from F11 but keeps state files
# long enough to read mcycle). Aggregator math:
#     CPI_i = delta_mcycle_i / vsim_icount
#     CPI   = sum_i ( w_i * CPI_i )
#     cycles_estimate = N_total_insns * CPI


def _read_state_mcycle(state_path: Path) -> int:
    """Read the mcycle field from a hybrid_state_v1 file via orchestrator.abi.

    Lazy import keeps `./hsim list` etc. from paying the ctypes layout
    check at startup.
    """
    tools_dir = str(REPO_ROOT / "tools")
    if tools_dir not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, tools_dir)
    from orchestrator.abi import HybridStateV1
    state = HybridStateV1.from_buffer_copy(state_path.read_bytes())
    return int(state.mcycle)


def _estimate_one_phase(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
                        slice_n: int, slice_at: int,
                        qemu_icount_fallback: int,
                        vsim_icount: int,
                        mmap_size: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Run one slice-consume QEMU + vsim drain pair, return mcycle pair.

    Mirrors _run_drain_pair (--mode slice in cmd_run) but keeps the
    state files long enough to read mcycle from both ends. Raises
    RuntimeError on drain rc != 200; caller handles cleanup of any
    partial output.
    """
    label = f"phase{slice_at}"
    shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
        mmap_size, prefix=f"hsim-{label}-shm.",
    )
    state_q_fd, state_q_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-qstate.")
    os.close(state_q_fd)
    state_q = Path(state_q_name)
    state_v_fd, state_v_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f"hsim-{label}-vstate.")
    os.close(state_v_fd)
    state_v = Path(state_v_name)
    try:
        # F14: when qemu_icount_fallback == 0, omit the icount= plugin extra
        # (plugin rejects icount=0). slice_consume is the primary trigger;
        # icount= is only a safety fallback for misconfigured slice_at.
        extras: tuple[str, ...] = (
            f"slice={slice_n}",
            f"slice_at={slice_at}",
        )
        if qemu_icount_fallback > 0:
            extras = (*extras, f"icount={qemu_icount_fallback}")
        qemu_argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
            shm_path, mmap_size, state_q,
            plugin_extras=extras,
        )
        proc = subprocess.run(
            qemu_argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-10:]
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"QEMU phase slice_at={slice_at} expected exit "
                f"{_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, got {proc.returncode}: "
                + "; ".join(tail)
            )
        mcycle_before = _read_state_mcycle(state_q)

        vsim_argv = _vsim_drain_argv(
            artifacts["vsim"], elf, state_q, state_v, vsim_icount,
        )
        proc = subprocess.run(
            vsim_argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_VSIM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-10:]
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"vsim phase slice_at={slice_at} expected exit "
                f"{_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, got {proc.returncode}: "
                + "; ".join(tail)
            )
        mcycle_after = _read_state_mcycle(state_v)
        return mcycle_before, mcycle_after
    finally:
        for p in (shm_path, state_q, state_v):
            try:
                p.unlink()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass


def _run_drain_at_exit_profile(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],
                                bbv: Path, slice_n: int,
                                mmap_size: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """F14: run a profile pass that drains at program exit (no icount cap).

    Returns (rc, n_total_insns). On rc != 0, n_total_insns is 0.

    The plugin's drain_at_exit=1 mode counts every retired insn via a
    per-insn exec cb and overrides the drained state file's `minstret`
    field with that count (QEMU's PMU minstret is host-tick-derived on
    system-mode without -icount, which is why we use the plugin counter).
    """
    shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
        mmap_size, prefix="hsim-profile-shm.",
    )
    state_fd, state_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hsim-profile-state.")
    os.close(state_fd)
    state_out = Path(state_name)
    try:
        argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
            shm_path, mmap_size, state_out,
            plugin_extras=(
                f"bbv_out={bbv}",
                f"slice={slice_n}",
                "drain_at_exit=1",
            ),
        )
        proc = subprocess.run(
            argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
        )
        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
            print(f"hsim: QEMU profile expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
            for line in tail:
                print(line, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1, 0

        if not bbv.is_file() or bbv.stat().st_size == 0:
            print(f"hsim: profile produced empty BBV: {bbv}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1, 0
        rows = sum(1 for _ in bbv.open())

        # Read N_total from the drained state file's minstret field
        # (overridden by the plugin's atexit counter).
        tools_dir = str(REPO_ROOT / "tools")
        if tools_dir not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, tools_dir)
        from orchestrator.abi import HybridStateV1
        state = HybridStateV1.from_buffer_copy(state_out.read_bytes())
        n_total = int(state.minstret)
        if n_total <= 0:
            print(f"hsim: drain-at-exit produced minstret={n_total} "
                  f"(plugin counter unexpectedly zero)", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1, 0

        print(f"profile: {rows} BBV rows -> {bbv} (N_total={n_total})")
        return 0, n_total
    finally:
        for p in (shm_path, state_out):
            try:
                p.unlink()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass


def cmd_estimate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    elf = Path(args.elf)
    if not elf.is_absolute():
        elf = (Path.cwd() / elf).resolve()
    if not elf.is_file():
        print(f"hsim: ELF not found: {args.elf}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    artifacts = _resolve_artifacts()
    for label, path in artifacts.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            print(f"hsim: {label} not built -- run ./hsim build",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
    if not _SIMPOINT_BIN.is_file():
        print("hsim: simpoint not built -- run ./hsim build",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    # SimPoint-correct default: vsim simulates exactly one slice's
    # insns per phase, so CPI_i = delta_mcycle / slice. 0 = "auto".
    vsim_icount = args.vsim_icount if args.vsim_icount > 0 else args.slice

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hsim-estimate-") as tmpdir:
        tmp = Path(tmpdir)
        bbv = tmp / "profile.bb"
        simpts = tmp / "simpts"
        weights = tmp / "weights"

        # F14: --icount 0 means run-to-program-exit; the plugin counts every
        # retired insn via atexit and writes it as minstret in the drained
        # state. --icount N > 0 keeps the legacy icount-cap path.
        if args.icount == 0:
            rc, n_total = _run_drain_at_exit_profile(
                elf, artifacts, bbv, args.slice, args.mmap_size,
            )
            if rc != 0:
                return rc
        else:
            rc = cmd_profile(argparse.Namespace(
                elf=str(elf), slice=args.slice, icount=args.icount,
                output=str(bbv), dry_run=False,
                mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
            ))
            if rc != 0:
                return rc
            n_total = args.icount

        rc = cmd_cluster(argparse.Namespace(
            bbv=str(bbv), max_k=args.max_k,
            simpts=str(simpts), weights=str(weights), dry_run=False,
        ))
        if rc != 0:
            return rc

        slice_indices = [int(line.split()[0])
                         for line in simpts.read_text().splitlines()
                         if line.strip()]
        weight_vals = [float(line.split()[0])
                       for line in weights.read_text().splitlines()
                       if line.strip()]
        if len(slice_indices) != len(weight_vals):
            print(f"hsim: simpts/weights row mismatch "
                  f"({len(slice_indices)} vs {len(weight_vals)})",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

        phases = []
        for K, w in zip(slice_indices, weight_vals):
            print(f"[hsim estimate] phase slice_at={K} weight={w:.3f}",
                  flush=True)
            try:
                mc_before, mc_after = _estimate_one_phase(
                    elf, artifacts, args.slice, K,
                    args.icount, vsim_icount,
                    mmap_size=args.mmap_size,
                )
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                print(f"hsim: estimate failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
            delta = mc_after - mc_before
            cpi = delta / vsim_icount if vsim_icount > 0 else 0.0
            phases.append({"K": K, "w": w, "delta": delta, "cpi": cpi})

        weighted_cpi = sum(p["w"] * p["cpi"] for p in phases)
        estimated_cycles = int(n_total * weighted_cpi)

        print(f"M4 profile: {len(slice_indices)} BBV rows ({bbv.name})")
        print(f"cluster: {len(phases)} phases")
        for p in phases:
            print(f"phase K={p['K']} w={p['w']:.3f} "
                  f"delta_mcycle={p['delta']} CPI={p['cpi']:.3f}")
        print(f"estimated_cycles={estimated_cycles}  "
              f"(N={n_total}, weighted_CPI={weighted_cpi:.3f})")
        return 0


# --- main -------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:

            "F9 (profile + cluster) and F11 (slice mode) end to end."

    )

        "--slice", dest="slice", type=int, default=1000,

    )
    p_estimate.add_argument(

        ),
    )
    p_estimate.add_argument(
        "--max-k", dest="max_k", type=int, default=2,
        help="SimPoint -maxK (default: 2; tiny BBVs need conservative K)",
    )
    p_estimate.add_argument(
        "--vsim-icount", dest="vsim_icount", type=int, default=0,
        help=(
            "vsim --hybrid-icount per phase (default: 0 -> use --slice "
            "for SimPoint-correct CPI math)"
        ),
    )
    p_estimate.add_argument(
        "--mmap-size", dest="mmap_size", type=_parse_mmap_size,
        default=_DEFAULT_MMAP_SIZE,
        help=(
            f"shared mmap size for the profile + per-phase drain pairs "
            f"(default: 128M; accepts SPEC like 8G, 512M, 1024). "
            f"Set HSIM_MMAP_DIR=/path to redirect off /dev/shm."
        ),
    )
    p_estimate.set_defaults(func=cmd_estimate)

    return parser


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if "--" in argv:
        idx = argv.index("--")
        head, tail = argv[:idx], argv[idx + 1:]
    else:
        head, tail = argv, []
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(head)
    args.extras = tail
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Demo (csr mode): CSR insn-match switching on the RVV GEMM workload.
#
# Profiles a KERNEL chosen by csrwi 0x7C0,{0,1} markers in the source. Walks
# one QEMU1 -> vsim -> QEMU2 round-trip on rt_c_v_matmul (16x16x16 RVV GEMM):
# QEMU1 seeds A/B, vsim runs the vmatmul_kernel between the markers (the
# measured window), QEMU2 verifies. This is the default switching path a user
# gets out of the box.
#
# Honors all the same env overrides as e2e.sh (VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU,
# VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM, TIMEOUT).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)

MODE_LABEL="CSR mode (profiles a kernel)"
echo "=========================================================="
echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
echo "Fixture: rt_c_v_matmul (RVV 16x16x16 GEMM)"
echo "Trigger: csrwi 0x7C0, 0 (enter) -> csrwi 0x7C0, 1 (exit)"
echo "=========================================================="

set +e
FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul TRIGGER_MODE=csr EXPECT_RC=0 TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}" \
  bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/../e2e.sh"
RC=$?
set -e

if [ "$RC" -eq 77 ]; then
  echo "[demo csr] SKIP (artifacts missing)"
  exit 77
fi

if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[demo csr] FAIL ($MODE_LABEL): underlying harness exit $RC"
  exit "$RC"
fi

echo "[demo csr] PASS ($MODE_LABEL)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Demo (SimPoint mode): headline whole-program flow on the RVV GEMM.
#
# The SimPoint-driven mode profiles the run into slices, clusters them into
# representative phases, measures each phase, and weight-combines into a
# whole-program cycle estimate. Its stages:
#
#   profile : QEMU+plugin bbv_out=,slice=N -> .bb file
#   cluster : tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint -loadFVFile ...
#   per-phase: QEMU+plugin slice=N,slice_at=K,outfile= -> drain
#   archive : write snap/K/{state.bin, mem, meta.json}
#   replay  : orchestrator replay-checkpoint --resume-with vsim
#   estimate: ./hsim estimate -> weighted-CPI whole-program cycle figure
#
# Workload: rt_c_v_matmul (marked RVV GEMM with natural csrwi 0x7C0,1 exit
# marker, so replay's hardcoded vsim+csr trigger drains naturally without
# --hybrid-icount tuning). As with the kernel-mode demos, the small
# slice/icount targets profile the crt0+init prefix BEFORE the enter marker;
# the GEMM kernel itself runs in the replay leg.
#
# Env (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
#   VSIM_QEMU     qemu-system-riscv64
#   VSIM_PLUGIN   libhybrid_handoff.so
#   VSIM_BIN      sim_<cpu>
#   VSIM_ELF      marked Tier-2 fixture (default: rt_c_v_matmul.elf)
#   SIMPOINT_BIN  tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint
#   WORKDIR       persistent dir (default: mktemp -d)
#   SLICE         insns per BBV row / per slice (default: 20)
#   PROFILE_ICOUNT plugin icount fallback for profile pass (default: 2000)
#   PHASE_ICOUNT  plugin icount fallback per phase run (default: 2000)
#   MAXK          simpoint -maxK (default: 2)

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_matmul}"
hybrid_resolve_paths
SIMPOINT_BIN="${SIMPOINT_BIN:-$TOP_ROOT/tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint}"
WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-$(mktemp -d -t demo-simpoint-XXXXXX)}"
SLICE="${SLICE:-20}"
PROFILE_ICOUNT="${PROFILE_ICOUNT:-2000}"
PHASE_ICOUNT="${PHASE_ICOUNT:-2000}"
MAXK="${MAXK:-2}"
# Defaults are tuned for the crt0+init prefix before csrwi 0x7C0,0. The
# marked GEMM's init_matrices makes that prefix longer than rt_c_v_regs's, so
# slice=20 yields ~63 BBV rows (more than enough for 2 clusters). Tune via env
# for other fixtures.

MODE_LABEL="SimPoint mode (whole-program estimate)"
echo "=========================================================="
echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
echo "Workload: $(basename "$VSIM_ELF")"
echo "Slice: $SLICE insns; profile icount: $PROFILE_ICOUNT; maxK: $MAXK"
echo "Workdir: $WORKDIR"
echo "=========================================================="

if [ ! -x "$SIMPOINT_BIN" ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] SKIP: $SIMPOINT_BIN not built"; exit 77
fi
if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] SKIP: python3 not found"; exit 77
fi

mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
BBV="$WORKDIR/profile.bb"
SIMPTS="$WORKDIR/simpts"
WEIGHTS="$WORKDIR/weights"
SP_LOG="$WORKDIR/simpoint.log"
SHM_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))

# ---- profile pass (stage 1) ----------------------------------------------------
echo "[demo simpoint 1/4] profile: bbv_out=,slice=$SLICE,icount=$PROFILE_ICOUNT"
SHM_PROFILE=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-sp-profile.XXXXXX)
PROFILE_STATE="$WORKDIR/profile_state.bin"
PROFILE_LOG="$WORKDIR/profile_qemu.log"
truncate -s "$SHM_SIZE" "$SHM_PROFILE"
trap 'rm -f "$SHM_PROFILE"' EXIT

set +e
timeout 30 "$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHM_PROFILE,size=$SHM_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$PROFILE_STATE,bbv_out=$BBV,slice=$SLICE,icount=$PROFILE_ICOUNT" \
  </dev/null >"$PROFILE_LOG" 2>&1
PRC=$?
set -e
rm -f "$SHM_PROFILE"

if [ "$PRC" -ne 200 ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: profile QEMU expected exit 200, got $PRC"
  tail -20 "$PROFILE_LOG"; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s "$BBV" ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: BBV file empty"; exit 1
fi
BBV_ROWS=$(wc -l < "$BBV")
echo "  $BBV_ROWS BBV rows -> $BBV"

# ---- cluster (stage 1): simpoint -----------------------------------------------
echo "[demo simpoint 2/4] cluster: simpoint -maxK $MAXK -dim 2"
set +e
"$SIMPOINT_BIN" -loadFVFile "$BBV" -maxK "$MAXK" -dim 2 \
  -saveSimpoints "$SIMPTS" -saveSimpointWeights "$WEIGHTS" \
  >"$SP_LOG" 2>&1
SP_RC=$?
set -e
if [ "$SP_RC" -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "$SIMPTS" ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: simpoint rc=$SP_RC; simpts size=$(wc -c <"$SIMPTS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  tail -20 "$SP_LOG"; exit 1
fi
NUM_PHASES=$(wc -l <"$SIMPTS")
echo "  $NUM_PHASES cluster representatives:"
awk '{printf "    slice=%s cluster=%s\n", $1, $2}' "$SIMPTS"

# ---- per-phase drain + archive (stages 2-3) -----------------------------------
echo "[demo simpoint 3/4] for each phase: drain at slice_at=K + archive"
PHASE_INDICES=$(awk '{print $1}' "$SIMPTS")
declare -a ARCHIVES=()
for K in $PHASE_INDICES; do
  SHM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm "vsim-sp-phase${K}.XXXXXX")
  truncate -s "$SHM_SIZE" "$SHM"
  STATE="$WORKDIR/phase_${K}_state.bin"
  Q_LOG="$WORKDIR/phase_${K}_qemu.log"

  set +e
  timeout 30 "$VSIM_QEMU" \
    -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHM,size=$SHM_SIZE" \
    -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
    -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
    -nographic \
    -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
    -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
    -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE,slice=$SLICE,slice_at=$K,icount=$PHASE_ICOUNT" \
    </dev/null >"$Q_LOG" 2>&1
  QRC=$?
  set -e

  if [ "$QRC" -ne 200 ]; then
    rm -f "$SHM"
    echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: phase $K QEMU exit $QRC"; tail -20 "$Q_LOG"; exit 1
  fi

  # archive: write snap/<K>/{state.bin, mem, meta.json} via the orchestrator's
  # write_archive helper (the canonical archive entry point used by F9).
  SNAP="$WORKDIR/snap/$K"
  set +e
  PYTHONPATH="$TOP_ROOT/tools" python3 - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
from orchestrator.checkpoint import write_archive
write_archive(
    Path("$SNAP"),
    state_path=Path("$STATE"),
    mmap_path=Path("$SHM"),
    mmap_size=$SHM_SIZE,
    elf_path="tests/fixtures/$(basename "$VSIM_ELF")",
    source_step_index=0,
    cpu_variant="ax45mpv_premium",
    region_id=f"snap/$K",
    slice_index=$K,
)
PY
  AR_RC=$?
  set -e
  rm -f "$SHM"
  if [ "$AR_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: write_archive for phase $K (rc=$AR_RC)"; exit 1
  fi
  for f in state.bin mem meta.json; do
    if [ ! -s "$SNAP/$f" ]; then
      echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: $SNAP/$f missing/empty"; exit 1
    fi
  done
  ARCHIVES+=("$SNAP")
  echo "  phase $K archived -> $SNAP"
done

# ---- replay each archive --------------------------------------------
echo "[demo simpoint 4/4] for each archive: replay-checkpoint --resume-with vsim"
REPLAY_OK=0
for SNAP in "${ARCHIVES[@]}"; do
  K=$(basename "$SNAP")
  REPLAY_WD="$WORKDIR/replay_$K"
  R_LOG="$WORKDIR/replay_${K}.log"
  mkdir -p "$REPLAY_WD"
  set +e
  PYTHONPATH="$TOP_ROOT/tools" VSIM_QEMU="$VSIM_QEMU" \
    VSIM_PLUGIN="$VSIM_PLUGIN" VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BIN" \
    timeout 120 python3 -m orchestrator.main replay-checkpoint "$SNAP" \
      --resume-with vsim --project-root "$TOP_ROOT" --workdir "$REPLAY_WD" \
      >"$R_LOG" 2>&1
  R_RC=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$R_RC" -eq 0 ] || [ "$R_RC" -eq 200 ]; then
    echo "  phase $K: replay OK (rc=$R_RC)"
    REPLAY_OK=$((REPLAY_OK + 1))
  else
    echo "  phase $K: replay FAILED (rc=$R_RC)"
    tail -15 "$R_LOG"
  fi
done

if [ "$REPLAY_OK" -ne "$NUM_PHASES" ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: $REPLAY_OK/$NUM_PHASES replays succeeded"
  exit 1
fi

# ---- whole-program cycle estimate (the SimPoint headline number) --------
# The chain above validates the profile->replay plumbing; the whole-program cycle
# figure comes from `hsim estimate` (profile -> cluster -> per-phase vsim
# measure -> weighted CPI x N_total). Reuses the same slice/maxK.
echo "[demo simpoint estimate] whole-program cycle estimate via ./hsim estimate"
EST_LOG="$WORKDIR/estimate.log"
set +e
VSIM_QEMU="$VSIM_QEMU" VSIM_PLUGIN="$VSIM_PLUGIN" VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BIN" \
  "$TOP_ROOT/hsim" estimate "$VSIM_ELF" \
    --slice "$SLICE" --max-k "$MAXK" --icount "$PROFILE_ICOUNT" >"$EST_LOG" 2>&1
EST_RC=$?
set -e
if [ "$EST_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: hsim estimate rc=$EST_RC"; tail -20 "$EST_LOG"; exit 1
fi
EST_CYCLES=$(grep -oE 'estimated_cycles=[0-9]+' "$EST_LOG" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
if [ "${EST_CYCLES:-0}" -le 0 ]; then
  echo "[demo simpoint] FAIL: hsim estimate produced no positive estimated_cycles"
  tail -20 "$EST_LOG"; exit 1
fi
echo "  estimated_cycles=$EST_CYCLES  (whole-program, weighted CPI)"

echo "[demo simpoint] PASS ($MODE_LABEL): bbv_rows=$BBV_ROWS phases=$NUM_PHASES replays_ok=$REPLAY_OK estimated_cycles=$EST_CYCLES workdir=$WORKDIR"
